I just confirmed with Pat Selter of PLM that he and a crew of at least four others will be out on Forest Lake treating flowering rush with the backpack tank sprayers on Wednesday, August 10. They plan to get to the 3rd lake public access at 10:00 am, and will be walking the shoreline and using a boat to get around as well. 

On a related note, Mike Sorensen performed the first round of experimental small patch hand cutting of flowering rush today. He plans to check on the area at least once a week from now on, and re-cut as necessary to keep the plants below the water’s surface.

Please let me know if you have any questions. 

Best, 

Emily Schmitz | Watershed Technician

Thanks.  Mike
